newsitem.title: UK: Gulf Canada extends bid for Clyde to Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada extends bid for Clyde to Feb 18.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it extended its hostile bid for Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc until 1300 GMT on February 18.
Gulf's offer had been scheduled to close on Tuesday, but the company raised its bid for Clyde to 120p per share from 105p.
However, Clyde spurned the offer, calling it inadequate.
Gulf said it held about 5.56 percent of Clyde's issued ordinary share capital and had acceptances covering about 0.17 percent by 1500 GMT on Tuesday.
Gulf previously held 7.4 million Clyde shares covering some 1.8 percent of stock and bought a further 15.5 million shares, or 3.76 percent.
Gulf Canada reiterated that its raised bid was final, although it said it could revise the offer in the event of a competitor emerging for Clyde.
